user_intent: 期望 亮度 处于 450 lux 到 600lux
期望 温度 处于 19℃ 到 25 ℃
如果 人在家 那么 降低 声音
IF 人不在家 THEN 清洁环境
如果发生火灾，那么开始报警
如果发生火灾，那么打开逃生通道

standard_taps: IF LG_brightness_sensor.get_brightness() < 450 AND aqara_motion_sensor.motion_state() == true THEN turn_light_up() philips_zhiyi_light
IF LG_brightness_sensor.get_brightness() > 600 AND aqara_motion_sensor.motion_state() == true THEN turn_light_down() philips_zhiyi_light
IF qingping_air_monitor.reading_temperature() > 25 AND aqara_motion_sensor.motion_state() == true THEN set_mode_to_cool() smart_inverter_air_conditioner
IF qingping_air_monitor.reading_temperature() < 19 AND aqara_motion_sensor.motion_state() == true THEN set_mode_to_heat() smart_inverter_air_conditioner
IF qingping_air_monitor.reading_PM2_5() > 70 AND aqara_motion_sensor.motion_state() == true THEN turn_on() mijia_air_purifier
IF aqara_motion_sensor.motion_state() == true THEN turn_low_volume() X_stereo
IF aqara_motion_sensor.motion_state() == false THEN start_sweep() viomi_vacuum
IF LG_fire_detector.is_fire() == true THEN beep() LG_fire_detector
IF LG_fire_detector.is_fire() == true THEN open_door() Blade_Star_smart_door
IF aqara_motion_sensor.motion_state() == false THEN turn_light_off() philips_zhiyi_light
IF aqara_motion_sensor.motion_state() == false THEN turn_off() smart_inverter_air_conditioner
IF aqara_motion_sensor.motion_state() == false THEN turn_off() mijia_air_purifier
IF aqara_motion_sensor.motion_state() == false THEN turn_off() X_stereo
